description: Road location and traffic data is a dataset listed in Peclet Queensland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. This dataset links to the Department of Transport and Main Roads road location details (both spatial and through distance) as well as associated traffic data. The data dictionary can be found on the State Open Data portal. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are roads, traffic. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-queensland-portal.
